Release notes/v0.13.5/Nov 21, 2026

What's new in Cadence 0.13.5.

> Windows: the installer is still building and will be added to this release shortly. The Mac app is ready now. Cadence Drive joins your Pro key's shared drive the moment the key is there, without a restart.

By Cadence Labs · Filed in Releases

§01 Fixed

  • Drive connects your computers right away. If you enter, buy or restore your Pro key while Drive is already on, that computer moves onto your key's shared drive at once, with the files already in its folder. Before, it stayed on a drive of its own until Cadence restarted, so your computers didn't see each other's files.
  • Drive problems now show up in Cadence's log, so a computer that can't sync says why.
